title: Multi-agent orchestration
description: Six tasks. Three workers. One review barrier. Open the control plane and follow a job.
prompt: Build two brand-new interactive examples in examples/ using the kit's rules (e.g., an interactive visualization of a Multi-Agent Orchestration Pipeline or a Distributed Token Bucket / Vector Index). Ensure both support Light and Dark themes and pass the visual joint/collision audit.
recipe: /cutaway a direct architectural cutaway of a planner, three workers, merge barrier, review, and output. Six tasks share a configurable worker pool. Open layers, step the model, and compare parallelism. Standalone HTML, both themes.
